desc.en: Technical lead for mobile and full-stack delivery: architecture, native Android/iOS and the .NET APIs behind them.

long_desc.en: Technical lead of the mobile and full-stack side of Solusoft's client products. I own the architectural decisions across AGEDI, Sisley, Iberext and EPDM, driving refactors towards a clean, multimodular architecture that shortens onboarding and makes features independently releasable. I lead the Transportes Chinchón programme end to end: native Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) and native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) apps shipped in feature parity on top of ApiMovil and Wemob, the internal .NET REST APIs I design and maintain. Day to day: architecture reviews, delivery planning in agile cycles and hands-on development across the stack.
long_desc.es: Referente técnico del lado móvil y full-stack de los productos de cliente de Solusoft. Llevo las decisiones de arquitectura en AGEDI, Sisley, Iberext y EPDM, impulsando refactorizaciones hacia una arquitectura limpia y multimodular que acorta el onboarding y permite publicar funcionalidades de forma independiente. Lidero de principio a fin el programa de Transportes Chinchón: apps nativas Android (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose) e iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) entregadas con paridad de funcionalidades sobre ApiMovil y Wemob, las APIs REST .NET internas que diseño y mantengo. En el día a día: revisiones de arquitectura, planificación de entregas en ciclos ágiles y desarrollo directo en toda la pila.

Took the Iberext fire-prevention app from the groundwork laid during my internship to a production release: a legacy Windows tablet application migrated to native Android on a multimodular clean architecture with Firebase, connected to a C#/.NET + SQL Server backend and used on 100+ devices.
